title: Brasilia Cathedral
blurb: Oscar Niemeyer's 1970 hyperboloid cathedral: 16 curved concrete columns rising 40 m from a 70 m circle, glazed between with stained glass, with its angels, evangelists, bell tower and baptistry.

systems.name: Hyperboloid columns
systems.description: The 16 identical curved concrete columns, each 42 m long and 90 tonnes, in three segments.

systems.name: Glass panels
systems.description: The fiberglass glazing between the columns, carrying Marianne Peretti's 1990 stained glass.

systems.name: Base and platform
systems.description: The circular base platform and its steps.

systems.name: Reflecting pool
systems.description: The 12 m wide, 40 cm deep reflecting pool ringing the cathedral.

systems.name: Entrance
systems.description: The ramp and tunnel passing beneath the pool into the church.

systems.name: Nave
systems.description: The underground nave: floor, altar, pews, baptistery fittings and the Way of the Cross.

systems.name: Suspended angels
systems.description: The three angels by Alfredo Ceschiatti hanging over the nave on steel cables.

systems.name: Evangelists
systems.description: The four bronze Evangelists by Ceschiatti at the entrance.

systems.name: Bell tower
systems.description: The separate bell tower with four bells donated by Spain.

systems.name: Baptistry
systems.description: The baptistry with its ovoid dome.
